supportQuality.coverage: Up to 2000 cases and 20000 lifecycle/grouping records per company. All bounded sources loaded. State coverage starts at each recorded state observation; old prose status notes never reconstruct missing history. Waiting and paused owners do not pause native SLA targets or elapsed durations. Business response minutes replay the current selected calendar, not historic calendar changes; replay is bounded to ten years and unavailable durations are excluded. Business sample: 2 cases. No employee-performance inference.
supportQuality.definition: Arrivals: cases created in [month start, activity cutoff). Resolution cohort: distinct cases with recorded resolution events in that interval. Reopen numerator: cohort cases with any later recorded reopening before report as-of, including cross-period reopenings; repeated resolutions/reopenings count once per case. Follow-up exposure differs between months. Response sample: arrival-cohort cases with a recorded first sent response before activity cutoff; unanswered cases are excluded from mean durations, never counted as zero. Resolution duration: creation to first recorded resolution in the interval, including waiting. Recorded merged aliases before activity cutoff are excluded, and their evidence remains visible. Category is the current native category, not reconstructed historical classification.

salesReport.definitions: Created-date cohort [company-local start,end), observed through month end or current as-of. Prior cohort uses the same elapsed duration. Conversion = last recorded won / created; win rate = won / (won+lost); each opportunity counted once. Undecided includes absent outcomes and reopened records. Median cycle = days from created to last recorded won/lost. Stage evidence uses recorded IDs, not mutable current stage. Forecast = amount × authoritative stage probability × (1 − risk × 0.5), risk defaults to 0.5 when unavailable; horizons 30/60/90 inclusive.
salesReport.ownershipCoverage: Actual opportunity owner and territory are not recorded by the current Sales model. Activity actors are event authors, not account owners. Territory allocations below are planning assumptions only.
salesReport.coverage: Nondeleted native opportunities and activities; deleted/missing history is outside this cohort. Zero denominators are unavailable. Missing recorded reasons are not inferred from activity summaries. Current forecast/workload is as-of now, separate from the selected period. Legacy forecast aggregates may lack retained inputs.
